items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Yeah, when I say Giles, Clay Giles. Clay Giles. Yeah, he was a drummer too.

ctx.x: That's what George told me he played since I was.
Yeah. And he used to use the fella for what he used to play with bass drum, what he used to play with the band in Thibodeau. Oh. Clay.
